mapper.sql: id, group_id, user_no, stdt_id, nickname, email, member_type, member_no, status, joined_at, left_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: /* GroupMemberMapper.updateGroupMember */ UPDATE group_member SET user_no = #{userNo}, stdt_id = #{stdtId}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, member_type = #{memberType}, member_no = #{memberNo}, status = #{status}, joined_at = #{joinedAt}, left_at = #{leftAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

/* GroupMemberMapper.updateGuestToStudent */ UPDATE group_member SET user_no = #{userNo}, member_type = 'STUDENT', updated_by = #{userNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE email = #{email} AND user_no IS NULL AND member_type = 'GUEST'
mapper.select: /* GroupMemberMapper.findActiveGuestByGroupIdAndEmail */ SELECT id, group_id, user_no, stdt_id, nickname, email, member_type, member_no, status, joined_at, left_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND email = #{email} AND user_no IS NULL AND member_type = 'GUEST' AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* GroupMemberMapper.syncSnapshotByUserNo */ UPDATE group_member SET nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND NOT (nickname <=> #{nickname} AND email <=> #{email})
